name: Ripio wBRL
oneLiner: WBRL is Ripio's wrapped Brazilian real stablecoin targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL, backed by BRL cash and local-currency instruments under Ripio's wFIAT issuance.
collateral: Brazilian-real fiat cash deposited in a Brazilian bank account, backing Ripio wBRL one-to-one against the Brazilian real per Ripio's wFIAT token certifications
pegMechanism: WBRL is issued and managed by Ripio against local fiat reserves, but ordinary holders do not have a documented direct redemption right with the issuer. Exits depend on secondary-market liquidity, Ripio on/off-ramp flows, or issuer-managed market operations.

mintAuthority.summary: WBRL is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

sources.label: Independent public accountant's certification of collateral backing wBRL tokens as of 2026-03-31
wFIAT whitepaper v1.0: attestations may be published periodically; wFIAT do not represent e-money and carry no redemption right

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe. Supervision review (2026-08-08): an independent third-party reserve certification exists - Pablo Eduardo Soto, CPA (CPCECABA Vol. 275 Folio 153) reconciled 719,448 wBRL outstanding across six chains against R$809,597.28 in a Brazilian bank account as of 2026-03-31 - so reserve evidence is attestation-backed rather than absent. Reconciliation stays unknown because Ripio labels this the first attestation of wBRL collateral, the wFIAT whitepaper commits only to attestations that 'may' be published periodically, and later-period certifications return 404. No prudential regime applies: the issuer is described only as a Ripio group affiliate, and the disclosed CNV PSAV and Florida money-transmitter registrations cover other group entities.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 across all six deterministic-address ERC-1967 deployments. Ethereum block 25712393, Base 49714331, Worldchain 33441185, BSC 114794465, Polygon 91675323, and Gnosis 47624683 all resolve implementation slot 0xfbab5dcb1647787ec8402a6509add256fa6c7f9d and paused() false; Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b holds PAUSER_ROLE on every deployment. Both verified LatamStable revisions route _update through ERC20PausableUpgradeable, so this EOA can halt every holder transfer. The Polygon/BSC/Gnosis revision additionally exposes COMPLIANCE_ROLE-gated blockUser/unblockUser and checks blocked senders and recipients when enforcement is enabled. A live global pause alone is a direct holder restriction and resolves the access verdict to Yes; the compliance-bearing deployments add holder-selective reach.
